text:
It looks like you had a very productive day focusing on setting up your new workspace!

We spent most of the time tackling the desk move, so I compiled that detailed checklist for you, which we saved as "Desk Move." We also updated that note with key logistics, making sure to include where the allen key and spare screws are located. When discussing setup details, we covered monitor height guidelines—keeping the top edge at or just below eye level.

I confirmed your afternoon schedule for 2:00 PM and 4:30 PM, and I’ve set a reminder for tonight so you remember to order cable ties or velcro straps. We also searched for places to recycle old electronics in Canberra; although I looked into it thoroughly, the results were mostly general articles and didn't provide specific drop-off locations.

On a much brighter note, I made sure to log your success that the desk actually fit through the door without needing to take the legs off—that saved you significant time! Just a reminder that I have set up two reminders for tomorrow: one at 9:00 AM about putting out the old chair for bulk pickup.

Have a restful evening, and I'll see you bright and early!
